description: cluster: 多尺度 cluster context 机制 — cluster bank 聚合点云特征→cluster_attn 把多尺度 context 回写更新 inst_feats→提升定位精度。注: 原'聚类路由'假设已被证伪(routing 生效反降点), 收益来自 context 而非 routing。目标 mIoU ≥ 0.51

findings.A1_context_only: champion Lite = 0.5012 (多尺度 context 按 ID 回写, 路由算了但 _cluster_to_points 丢弃不用 → 实质 context-only)
findings.A3_routing_active: TrueRoute = 0.4468 (路由索引真影响 message) → 比 A1 低 0.0544, routing 生效反害
findings.context_claim: A1−A0 = 0.0118 ≥ 0.005 ✓ 确认 (多尺度 context 有效)
findings.routing_claim: A3−A1 = -0.0544 < 0.002 ✗ 证伪 (routing 无独立收益, 反有害)
findings.A4_shuffle_control: running(07-20 13:03 启动, 0.3900@ep4 early) — 验证 A3 的崩是内容路由有害还是结构注入有害
findings.D1_detail_relause: D1-detail(relaunch)=0.5003@ep28 stopped_unknown — 距 champion 0.5012 仅 0.0009, detail 单独有效(γ=+0.0109); detail > detail+residual(E4=0.4944)
findings.E4_res_detail_terminal: E4-residual+detail=0.4944@ep23 stopped_unknown — residual与detail无协同, residual上限~0.4944(=B5单独), 组合无增益
findings.pending_mechanisms: M1-QGC(query-gated context, running 07-20 16:03); M6-QSF(waiting); M16-CSR(waiting); M17-ORT(orth reg, waiting)

constraints: FLOPs ≤ 10.0G; 峰值显存 +15% 需 ≥+0.003 mIoU 才保留
整体统一修正前禁止单变体改 schedule (epochs=50/max_iters=70 不一致暂保持)
